title: 第3章 她们是真双修是我太肤浅第4章 我是凡人但能批量造女神
content_zh:
万万没想到，素衣居然是双修宫宫主，还是玄土星最顶尖的修炼者，没有之一！
万万没想到，我一个修炼界的新手，起点居然这么高，简直是开场即巅峰，没有之一！
万万没想到，双修宫竟是纯女性宗门，所谓双修，其实是科技与修炼的融合之道。
她们是真双修，是我太肤浅！
素衣对容羞可亲了，一声声“姐姐”叫得又甜又软。
她还让容羞负责教授弟子们科技知识，这本该是我的工作。
可这事我真做不来。
她们一掌拍下去，一颗石子就能化为虚无。
这质量守恒吗？
这能量守恒吗？
我那颗信仰科学的心，还能守恒吗？
……
素衣也给我安排了个轻松活计：负责弟子们的“洗澡水”。
她们修炼时，需要泡在水中抵消重力干扰，这水就是“洗澡水”。
每天大概要更换几百万吨清水，当然不用我一桶一桶去挑。
水库、水渠她们早就准备好了，我只需要负责开闸、关闸就行。
其实我更想专心修炼，可素衣的一句话，让我彻底死了心。
原来修炼必须先激活“灵体”，修炼者之所以强大，全靠灵体加持。
没有灵体，那就是凡人。
绝大多数玄土星人天生就能激活灵体，属于“五行灵体”中的“土灵体”。

“五行灵体”还有“金灵体”“水灵体”“木灵体”“火灵体”。
菁缨和所有玄水星人，天生都是水灵体。
而地球人类根本没有灵体，只能修炼那些无需灵体的基础功法，比如“基础调息”“养玉功”。
那能不能后天激活灵体？
素衣只知道一种方法：掠夺与自己血脉融合的双修伴侣的灵体。
血脉融合？
恐怕只有地球人才和我血脉契合，能实现融合。
可地球人都没有灵体。
这条路，从一开始就堵死了。
“基础调息”我早就不练了，除了能“辟谷”，再没别的效果。
玄土星人天生就能“辟谷”，更不会特意去修炼这种基础功法。
……
“养玉功”，或者说“鸿蒙玉契诀”，算得上是至高无上的神秘功法，只可惜是残缺的。
据说修炼到极致能实现永生，还能突破境界桎梏，超凡入圣。
没人会怀疑这些信息的真实性，它们来自功法自带的遗传记忆。
只要开始凝练“本命玉”，就能解锁这部分传承信息。
虽说是双修功法，但凝练“本命玉”的阶段，只需女方单独修炼即可。
“本命玉”会给凝练者一种特殊感应，凭着这种感应，就能找到与自己契合的双修伴侣。
“本命玉”可以分出一半“本命阳玉”，融合给男方；剩下的一半“本命阴玉”，则会被女方自行吸收。
男方获得“本命阳玉”后，双方的双修契约便会激活，开启下一阶段修炼。

只可惜，这后续的修炼方法已经失传了。
水菁缨只是听闻过“养玉功”的神奇，还没来得及凝聚“本命玉”就和我双修了。
现在她再也没法凝聚“本命玉”了。
可她没死心，天天守在我身边，话语中时不时透露，想和我再试试双修。
content_en:
I never expected that Su Yi would be the master of the Dual Cultivation Palace and the top cultivator of Xuantu Planet, no one!
I never expected that I, a newbie in the world of cultivation, would have such a high starting point. I would reach the peak right from the beginning, like no other!
I never expected that the Dual Cultivation Palace was actually a purely female sect. The so-called dual cultivation was actually the fusion of technology and cultivation.
They are truly dual cultivators, but I am too superficial!
Su Yi was so shy and approachable to Rong, and she called "Sister" sweetly and softly.
She also asked Rong Sha to be responsible for teaching the disciples scientific and technological knowledge, which should have been my job.
But I really can't do this.
With one slap of their palm, a pebble can be turned into nothingness.
Is this mass conserved?
Is this energy conserved?
Can my faith in science still be preserved?
…
Suyi also arranged an easy job for me: to be responsible for the "bath water" for the disciples.
When they practice, they need to soak in water to offset the interference of gravity. This water is called "bath water."
Approximately millions of tons of clean water need to be replaced every day. Of course, I don’t need to carry buckets of them.
They have already prepared the reservoirs and canals, and I only need to be responsible for opening and closing the gates.
In fact, I wanted to concentrate on my cultivation, but Su Yi's words made me completely give up.
It turns out that cultivation must first activate the "spirit body". The reason why a practitioner is strong depends entirely on the blessing of the spirit body.
If there is no spirit, then we are just mortals.
The vast majority of Xuantu people are born with the ability to activate their spiritual bodies and belong to the "earth spiritual body" among the "five elements of spiritual bodies".
The "Five Elements Spirit Body" also includes the "Gold Spirit Body", "Water Spirit Body", "Wood Spirit Body" and "Fire Spirit Body".
Jingying and all Xuanshui Star people are born with water spirit bodies.
Humans on earth do not have spiritual bodies at all, and can only practice basic exercises that do not require spiritual bodies, such as "Basic Breathing Adjustment" and "Yu Jade Technique".
Can the spirit body be activated the day after tomorrow?
Su Yi only knows one way: to plunder the spirit body of her dual cultivation partner who has merged with her bloodline.
Bloodline fusion?
I'm afraid only the people on Earth are of the same bloodline as me and can achieve fusion.
But no one on earth has a spirit body.
This road has been blocked from the beginning.
I stopped practicing "Basic Breath Adjustment" a long time ago, and it has no other effect except "eliminating grains".
Xuantu people are born with the ability to "big grain", and they will not go out of their way to practice this basic skill.
…
The "Jade Raising Technique", or the "Hongmeng Jade Deed", can be regarded as the supreme mysterious technique, but unfortunately it is incomplete.
It is said that if you practice to the extreme, you can achieve eternal life, break through the shackles of realm, and become a saint.
No one will doubt the authenticity of this information, which comes from the genetic memory inherent in the practice.
As long as you start condensing the "Bird Jade", you can unlock this part of the inheritance information.
Although it is a dual cultivation technique, in the stage of condensing the "birth jade", the woman only needs to practice it alone.
"Bird Jade" will give the condenser a special feeling. With this feeling, he can find a dual cultivation partner who is compatible with him.
The "natal jade" can separate half of the "natal yang jade" and fuse it with the man; the remaining half of the "natal yin jade" will be absorbed by the woman.
After the man obtains the "Born Yang Jade", the double cultivation contract between the two parties will be activated and the next stage of cultivation will begin.
Unfortunately, this subsequent cultivation method has been lost.
Shui Jingying had only heard about the magic of the "Jade Nourishment Technique", and she practiced it with me before she had time to gather the "Jade of Origin".
Now she can no longer gather the "birth jade".
But she didn't give up and stayed by my side every day. From time to time she revealed in her words that she wanted to try dual cultivation with me again.
